Strasbourg, France
One quick day trip to this city in France left me wanting more.

I really love Strasbourg.

I’d love to go back.

The mix of French and German in the architecture and the food is awesome.

I thoroughly enjoyed wandering the streets, popping into shops and churches and eating some tasty food.

Of course, my experience was enhanced by being with friends on this day trip.

We had a lot of fun.

The cathedral is amazing!

And of course, there are delicious wines to drink too.

Strasbourg is one of the European cities I would love to — and plan to — spend more time in.

Just beautiful!
